blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 58-year-old dump truck driver died while two others were injured in a collision involving three dump trucks in Real, Quezon, on Saturday night, the police said. In a report on Sunday, the Quezon police said a dump truck driven by alias “Joel,” 50, was forced to stop after another vehicle suddenly entered the highway in Barangay Tignoan at around 7 p.m. The said truck was rear-ended by another dump truck driven by alias “Celso,” 48. Moments later, a third dump truck driven by alias “Encio,” 58, reportedly traveling at high speed, failed to stop in time and slammed into the […]...
